clips.send: Lens. Convex lenses converge light; concave lenses diverge it. A convex lens is thicker in the middle. It bends parallel rays so they meet at the focal point (F). The distance from the lens to F is the focal length. A fatter lens has a shorter focal length. A concave lens is thinner in the middle. It spreads parallel rays apart, as if they came from a focal point in front of it. Your eye has a convex lens that focuses an image on the retina. Glasses for nearsighted people use concave lenses; for farsighted people, convex lenses.

clips.send: Plane mirror. Reflects light: angle in equals angle out. Law of reflection: the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection. A smooth surface gives regular (mirror) reflection; a rough surface scatters light in many directions (diffuse reflection). An image in a plane mirror is upright, the same size, left–right reversed and appears as far behind the mirror as the object is in front. The back of this mirror is painted, so light hitting the back is absorbed.

clips.send: Laser (light source). Makes a narrow, straight beam of light. Light is an electromagnetic wave. It needs no air or water to travel, so sunlight can cross empty space to reach us. In one material, light travels in straight lines. We draw these paths as rays with arrows. Light is the fastest thing in the universe: about 300,000 km every second in a vacuum.

clips.send: White screen. Catches the light so we can see where it lands. A white surface reflects all colors in every direction (diffuse reflection), so everyone in the room can see the spot. The screen is opaque: no light passes through it. Transparent materials (clear glass) let light through; translucent ones (wax paper) let some through but scatter it; opaque ones (wood) block it.

clips.send: Normal line. An imaginary line at 90° to the surface. The dashed yellow line is the normal. It is drawn wherever light hits a surface. The angle of incidence (i) and the angle of reflection or refraction (r) are measured from the normal. A ray that travels exactly along the normal does not bend when it enters glass.

clips.send: Light ray. A model of the path light takes. The moving dots show the direction light travels. When light meets matter it can be reflected (bounce), refracted/transmitted (pass through and bend) or absorbed (turned into heat). You see an object when light from it (made or reflected) enters your eyes.

clips.send: Glass block. Refraction: light bends when its speed changes. Light slows from about 300,000 km/s in air to about 200,000 km/s in glass. Entering glass (fast, slow), the ray bends TOWARD the normal. Leaving (slow, fast), it bends AWAY. With parallel sides, the ray comes out parallel to the way it went in, just shifted sideways. If light inside glass hits the surface at a big angle (more than about 42°), it cannot escape: total internal reflection. Optical fibers use this.

clips.send: Triangular prism. Splits white light into colors (dispersion). White light is a mixture of all the colors of the rainbow. Each color slows by a slightly different amount in glass, so each bends a different amount. Violet bends most, red bends least. The order is always red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet (ROYGBIV). Raindrops act like tiny prisms, which is how rainbows form. Switch the beam to White to see it. (The spreading is exaggerated here so you can see it clearly.)

clips.send: 光线。表示光传播路径的模型。移动的小光点表示光传播的方向。光遇到物质时，可能被反射（弹回）、透射并折射（穿过并偏折），或被吸收（转化为热）。物体发出或反射的光进入你的眼睛，你才能看见它。

clips.send: 玻璃砖。折射：光速改变时光会偏折。光在空气中每秒约 30 万千米，进入玻璃后减慢到每秒约 20 万千米。从空气进入玻璃（快，慢）时，光线向法线偏折；离开玻璃（慢，快）时，远离法线偏折。两个面平行时，出射光与入射光平行，只是向旁边平移了一段。光在玻璃里以很大的角度（大于约 42 度 ）射到界面时，出不去，全部被反射回来，这叫全反射，光纤就利用了它。

clips.send: 三棱镜。把白光分解成各种色光（色散）。白光是由彩虹中各种颜色的光混合而成的。不同颜色的光在玻璃中减慢的程度略有不同，偏折程度也不同：紫光偏折最多，红光偏折最少。颜色顺序总是：红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、靛、紫。雨滴就像一个个小棱镜，所以会形成彩虹。把光束切换成“白光”来观察。（为了看清楚，这里的色散效果做了夸大。）

clips.send: 激光器（光源）。发出一束又细又直的光。光是一种电磁波。它的传播不需要空气或水，所以阳光能穿过真空的太空到达地球。光在同一种均匀介质中沿直线传播，我们用带箭头的“光线”表示它的路径。光是宇宙中最快的：在真空中每秒约传播 30 万千米。

clips.send: 白色光屏。接收光，让我们看清光落在哪里。白色表面把各种颜色的光向各个方向反射（漫反射），所以屋里每个人都能看见光斑。光屏是不透明的，光不能穿过它。透明物体（如玻璃）让光通过；半透明物体（如蜡纸）让部分光通过但会把它散开；不透明物体（如木头）挡住光。

clips.send: 法线。与界面垂直（90 度 ）的假想线。黄色虚线就是法线，画在光线射到界面的那一点。入射角（i） 和反射角、折射角（r） 都是从法线量起的。沿法线方向射入玻璃的光不会发生偏折。
clips.text: 法线. 与界面垂直（90°）的假想线. 黄色虚线就是法线，画在光线射到界面的那一点。. 入射角（i） 和反射角、折射角（r） 都是从法线量起的。. 沿法线方向射入玻璃的光不会发生偏折。

clips.send: 透镜。凸透镜会聚光线，凹透镜发散光线。凸透镜中间厚、边缘薄，它让平行光会聚到一点，这一点叫焦点（F）。焦点到透镜中心的距离叫焦距。透镜越“胖”，焦距越短。凹透镜中间薄、边缘厚，它让平行光发散开，好像是从透镜前方的焦点射出来的。眼睛里有一个凸透镜（晶状体），把像成在视网膜上。近视眼镜用凹透镜，远视眼镜用凸透镜。

clips.send: 平面镜。反射光：入射角 等于 反射角。光的反射定律：反射角等于入射角。光滑表面发生镜面反射；粗糙表面把光向四面八方反射，叫漫反射。平面镜成的像是正立、等大的虚像，左右相反，像到镜面的距离等于物体到镜面的距离。这面镜子的背面涂了漆，射到背面的光会被吸收。
